Ensure construction activities are carried out as per approved drawings, technical specifications, method statements and applicable standards. Prepare and maintain Inspection Requests (IRs), Quality Reports, NCRs, Corrective Action Reports and inspection records. Maintain complete Quality Documentation / Quality Dossier for project handover. Coordinate with testing & commissioning teams for quality clearance and punch-point closure. Ensure all quality records are properly compiled for final project handover and as-built documentation. Support client/consultant inspections and audits. Strong hands-on experience in both Electrical and Civil QA/QC activities in MW-scale solar projects. Candidates with experience in EPC Solar Power Projects will be preferred. Good knowledge of construction quality standards, inspection procedures and testing requirements. Ability to read and interpret Electrical SLDs, IFC drawings, civil drawings and technical specifications. Good knowledge of ITPs, Method Statements, NCRs, Inspection Requests and Quality Documentation. Experience in handling clients, consultants, subcontractors and third-party inspection agencies. Preferred Skills Strong knowledge of utility-scale solar PV plant end to end site execution and QA/QC processes. Good knowledge of applicable IS/IEC standards and project specifications. Strong inspection and reporting skills. Good communication and coordination skills. Ability to identify quality issues and implement effective corrective actions. Ability to work independently at remote project sites. Willingness to travel and work at project locations across India. Proficiency in MS Office and preparation of QA/QC reports. Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate will be a hands-on Solar QA/QC professional who has successfully worked on utility-scale MW solar projects and can independently monitor quality across both Electrical and Civil scopes, from initial construction through testing, commissioning and project handover.
